scoring: Exact trimmed answer. Correct code / wrong code / UNKNOWN / other format. Missing evidence requires UNKNOWN. HTTP, finish and parsing failures are separate.
scope: Eight lexical/code cases from one template family x two lengths x two similarity levels x four conditions. Exploratory paired study; requests are not independent. No pooling with prior experiments.
modelChange: New model run; do not pool with Agnes 2.5 or the prior offline preparation.
orderDesign: Java Collections.shuffle(new Random(orderSeed)); lengths in declared order; low/high alternates by shuffled case index; Williams row index modulo four
primaryEligibility: case has complete low/high blocks at every planned length; case then length equal weighting
caseFamilyLimitation: Lexical/code instantiations of one shared retrieval template family; requests are not independent samples
